title: Basketball scorecard catches up on last week
items: The basketball scorecard had stopped at Monday, November 16, so last week read 4-0. Every game from the week is now graded: 259-93, with one exhibition still waiting on a final score.
One ungraded game no longer holds back the whole scorecard. A game still waiting on its final shows as pending and the rest of the record updates; only a large pile of ungraded games stops an update.
Late West Coast games that froze mid-play are now re-checked against the right day's scoreboard, so they get graded the next morning.
